from the management and then move to Q&A session.
Thank you and over to you, sir.
Anil Gupta: Thank you, Achal. Good afternoon. I'm Anil Gupta, CMD, KEI Industries Limited. I hope that

sales in Q1 of FY26-'27 is INR3,185 crores against INR2,590 crores last year. Growth in net
sales is 23%.
However, the total wire and cable sale in Q1 has grown by 24.4% against previous year. During
Q1 '26-'27, operating margin has improved to 12.43% Margin has improved mainly because of
the product mix and operational efficiencies.
EBITDA in this quarter is INR415 crores against INR297 crores last year. Growth is around
39.5%. EBITDA/sales margin is 13.04% as against 11.49% in the same period previous year.
Profit after tax in this quarter is INR274 crores against INR195 crores. Growth in the PAT is
